# CUSA14876 validation

This fork adds an experimental profile for the European 1.21 executable. It does not
assume that every regional executable shares the upstream CUSA13795 patch addresses.
No game files or proprietary executable bytes are distributed by this repository.

## Identity checks

The loaded executable image must have SHA-256:

```
6b93d1f682fbfc5340dfd08360c8c0522a40f34585ec525c41537c40772bb39c
```

Its `sce_sys/param.sfo` must report `TITLE_ID=CUSA14876` and `APP_VER=01.21`.
An unknown European executable is rejected even when its metadata claims 1.21.
The known base 1.00 executable is rejected; pairing its bytes with 1.21 metadata does
not pass validation. Existing CUSA13795 behavior is retained.

Extract the matching base and update separately, then use `tools/merge_update.py` to
create a separate merged directory. Do not mix region metadata or executable files.
The game folder is read-only to the runtime; generated data and saves are separate.

## Observed native results

A local test on an NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 verified:

```
Crash™ Team Racing Nitro-Fueled | entry=0x80 | image=46,065,261 bytes
Update build: CUSA14876 01.21 (validated-1.21; sdk_ver=06008000); patch sites are found by signature
713 imported symbols; 473,760 relocations; 52 required modules
libc _init_env verified RET: True
Linked modules: libc.prx@0x2bf0000, libSceFios2.prx@0x2d20000, libSceNpToolkit2.prx@0x2eb0000; 290 native bindings, 730 imports left to the host runtime, fs->gs patched=3747
Import names: 730 imports, 729 named, 1 unnamed
```

The native renderer displayed the Beenox intro, opened an eight-channel audio
port and reached the title screen with the “Press X to Begin” prompt during a
120-second bounded test. This establishes native initialization and intro rendering, not completed
races, stable frame pacing or full gameplay compatibility. The user's separate
shadPS4 title-screen test is not counted as native-port evidence.

Three matching DLC entitlement packages were detected:

```
Runtime: add-on CTRDELUXEPACK001 (installed)
Runtime: add-on CTRPREORDERPACK1 (installed)
Runtime: add-on CTRCODEKART00001 (installed)
AppContent profile: SKU=full (probe setting), user params=[1, 0, 0, 0], add-ons=3
```

Detection does not prove every DLC item is usable in gameplay. Point `BB_DLC_DIR`
at the directory containing your matching DLC packages. Other regions are filtered.

## Patch validation

All three bundled community patches produced one validated write each. Actual image
offsets found for the 60 FPS and Pro 1080p patches were `0x13a9d80` and `0x13a9da4`.
The 480p and 720p render patches produced three writes each, 1620p one, and 2160p two.
1080p and 1440p use the game's own paths and require no render-scale writes.
Every relocated patch site must match a unique signature; missing or ambiguous sites
are skipped. This checks byte placement, not performance or visual quality at every resolution.

## Remaining validation

Complete races, saving/loading, each DLC item, regional non-English languages,
resolution changes during gameplay and long sessions remain unverified. The launcher's
language list is inherited from upstream; only the default English was used here.

## Regression checks

The local suite discovered 133 tests: 105 passed and 28 were skipped because the
C test binaries were not built locally. GTK integration used the desktop display
with the Cairo renderer and an in-memory settings backend. CI builds the C binaries
before running the full suite in an isolated display; its result is tracked separately.
The launch-script overlay fixture was updated for the new JSON profile protocol.
